title: Unresponsive person
text: Check the scene is safe, then tap the shoulders and shout: are you okay?
Call for the crew medical officer and put the emergency call out on the loop.
Open the airway with head tilt, chin lift; check for normal breathing for no more than 10 seconds.
If breathing normally, place in the recovery position and monitor. If not breathing normally, start CPR immediately.
Restrain the patient on a rigid surface before anything else; in microgravity both of you drift otherwise.
Check for normal breathing for no more than 10 seconds.
If breathing normally, restrain the person so they cannot drift and turn the head to the side if vomiting — there is no recovery position in microgravity.
If not breathing normally, start microgravity CPR immediately: restrain the patient and use the Evetts-Russomano or handstand method.

inflight.note: This variant follows the microgravity guideline; in partial gravity (Moon base, rover) use the Earth steps above.
